# Layout modifiers

> Generated from the source doc comments. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p choscorui-api-docs --locked`. The [index](README.md) lists every item. Every example assumes `use choscorui::prelude::*;`.

## Layout modifiers

### `aspect_ratio`

```rust
fn aspect_ratio(self, ratio: f64) -> Styled<Self>
```

Keeps width ÷ height at `ratio`, with the width the view gets.

#### Examples

```rust
let preview = Text::new("Preview").aspect_ratio(16.0 / 9.0);
```

### `fixed_size`

```rust
fn fixed_size(self) -> Styled<Self>
```

Keeps the view at its measured size when the parent overflows.

#### Examples

```rust
let status = Text::new("Connected").fixed_size();
```

### `frame`

```rust
fn frame<M>(self, frame: impl IntoLive<Frame, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Size constraints, with the content aligned in the frame. A live
frame, such as a closure, updates the layout when it changes.

#### Examples

```rust
let title = Text::new("Title")
    .frame(Frame::new().width(200.0).alignment(Alignment::LEADING));
```

### `hidden`

```rust
fn hidden<M>(self, hidden: impl IntoLive<bool, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Hides the view but keeps its space.

#### Examples

```rust
let saved = Text::new("Saved").hidden(true);
```

### `layout_direction`

```rust
fn layout_direction<M>(self, direction: impl IntoLive<LayoutDirection, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The layout direction of the view, instead of the locale's.

#### Examples

```rust
let row = HStack::new((Text::new("A"), Text::new("B")))
    .layout_direction(LayoutDirection::Rtl);
```

### `layout_priority`

```rust
fn layout_priority(self, priority: f64) -> Styled<Self>
```

A share of the leftover space along the parent stack.

#### Examples

```rust
let row = HStack::new((
    Text::new("A long file name").layout_priority(1.0),
    Text::new("12 KB"),
));
```

### `offset`

```rust
fn offset<M>(self, offset: impl IntoLive<Point, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Moves the painted view without changing its layout.

#### Examples

```rust
let badge = Text::new("3").offset(Point::new(4.0, -4.0));
```

### `padding`

```rust
fn padding(self, edges: impl Into<Edges>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Space around the view, on all or on logical edges.

#### Examples

```rust
let note = Text::new("Hello").padding(Space::S4);
let row = Text::new("Name").padding(Edges::horizontal(Space::S2));
```
